nodes.name: Code | Validate Qdrant Privacy Request | PrivacyQdrant

parameters.jsCode: 'use strict';const x=$input.first()?.json||{};const p=x.payload||{};const t=v=>String(v??'').normalize('NFKC').trim();const raw=t(x.requestType||x.operation).toLowerCase();const operation=raw==='delete_confirm'?'delete':(raw==='delete_preview'?'preview':raw);const collection=t(x.qdrantCollection||p.qdrant_collection||p.qdrantCollection);const requestId=t(x.requestId||p.request_id||p.requestId);if(!['export','preview','delete'].includes(operation))throw new Error('privacy_qdrant_invalid_operation');if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,240}$/.test(collection))throw new Error('privacy_qdrant_collection_invalid');if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,160}$/.test(requestId))throw new Error('privacy_qdrant_request_id_invalid');return [{json:{...x,requestType:operation,requestId,qdrantCollection:collection,adapter:'qdrant'}}];

parameters.jsCode: 'use strict';const req=$('Code | Validate Qdrant Privacy Request | PrivacyQdrant').first().json;if(req.requestType==='export'){const source=$('Code | Validate Qdrant Snapshot Creation | PrivacyQdrant').first().json;let r={};try{r=JSON.parse(String($json.stdout||'{}').trim())}catch{throw new Error('privacy_qdrant_snapshot_download_receipt_invalid')};if(r.success!==true||!r.snapshotLocalPath||!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(String(r.snapshotSha256))||!(Number(r.snapshotBytes)>0))throw new Error('privacy_qdrant_snapshot_download_failed');return [{json:{adapter:'qdrant',success:true,retryable:false,receipt:{contractVersion:'chelsea_qdrant_privacy_receipt_v2',operation:'export',collection:req.qdrantCollection,snapshotName:source.snapshotName,...r,requestId:req.requestId,completedAt:new Date().toISOString()},errorMessage:''}}]}let body=$json?.body??$json?.data??$json;try{if(typeof body==='string')body=JSON.parse(body)}catch{}const status=Number($json?.statusCode||$json?.status||0);const absent=status===404||body?.status?.error?.includes?.('doesn\'t exist')||body?.result===null;if(!absent)throw new Error('privacy_qdrant_delete_readback_collection_still_accessible');return [{json:{adapter:'qdrant',success:true,retryable:false,receipt:{contractVersion:'chelsea_qdrant_privacy_receipt_v2',operation:'delete',collection:req.qdrantCollection,verifiedAbsent:true,completedAt:new Date().toISOString()},errorMessage:''}}];

nodes.name: Code | Validate Qdrant Snapshot Creation | PrivacyQdrant

parameters.jsCode: 'use strict';const req=$('Code | Validate Qdrant Privacy Request | PrivacyQdrant').first().json;const raw=$input.first()?.json||{};const body=raw.body??raw.data??raw;const snap=String(body?.result?.name||body?.name||'').trim();if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,240}$/.test(snap))throw new Error('privacy_qdrant_snapshot_receipt_missing');return [{json:{...req,snapshotName:snap}}];

nodes.name: Execute Command | Download Qdrant Snapshot | PrivacyQdrant

parameters.command: =set -euo pipefail; ROOT="${CHELSEA_PRIVACY_EXPORTS_ROOT:-/files/chelsea_privacy_exports}"; REQUEST='{{ $json.requestId }}'; COLLECTION='{{ $json.qdrantCollection }}'; SNAP='{{ $json.snapshotName }}'; OUTDIR="$ROOT/$REQUEST"; case "$REQUEST$COLLECTION$SNAP" in *[!A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*) echo '{"success":false,"error":"invalid_snapshot_path"}'; exit 2;; esac; install -d -m 0700 "$OUTDIR"; OUT="$OUTDIR/qdrant.snapshot"; BASE="${CHELSEA_QDRANT_URL:-http://qdrant:6333}"; curl -fsS --retry 2 --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 300 -H "api-key: $CHELSEA_QDRANT_API_KEY" "$BASE/collections/$COLLECTION/snapshots/$SNAP" -o "$OUT"; chmod 0600 "$OUT"; BYTES=$(stat -c %s "$OUT"); [ "$BYTES" -gt 0 ] || exit 3; SHA=$(sha256sum "$OUT"|awk '{print $1}'); printf '{"success":true,"snapshotLocalPath":"%s","snapshotBytes":%s,"snapshotSha256":"%s"}\n' "$OUT" "$BYTES" "$SHA"
